answer: I would stop farms with genome consent hash with biobank attestation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the crystal of the check, count the horizon of the cost, and read the shale of the history before any answer is graded. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
